display_long_description:
# Play the Most Ridiculous VR Shooter on Quest

The AI bots are out of control, harvesting human knowledge and stunting creativity. Join the rebellion, destroy the bots and reabsorb your knowledge!

**Bigger Head, Bigger Plays**

The more knowledge-orbs you absorb, the bigger your head grows. The bigger your head, the higher you jump and your voice... well, let’s just say - embrace your helium status!
 
Soar across the arena with your massive head, destroy the bots and pick your moment to deposit knowledge at the banking stations... then do it all again.

**Two Modes: of play: Solo or Multiplayer:**

 
Arcade (Quick Play): Pure combat. Pure fun. Terminate bots, collect knowledge, deposit and repeat.
MindTap (Quiz mode): Did you get taken out by the bots? No problem, answer a question correctly. Choose an upgrade and spawn back in to the game, ready for revenge!

**The AI Wants You Gone!**


Take on various bots in their wacky hallucinated formats. Each one drops knowledge-orbs when terminated, they're less "enemies" more "walking databases that shoot back”.

**Power-Ups include:**


Shield. Shotgun. Minigun. Hackgun. Speed boost. Use them. Lose them. Cry about it... in your whiny helium voice!

**Launching With**


- 3 modes: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, PvE
- 2 maps (more coming)
- 1 oversized head
